claims.text: Defense Intelligence Reference Document titled "Warp Drive, Dark Energy, and the Manipulation of Extra Dimensions", series "Acquisition Threat Support", published 2010-04-02 with an Intelligence Cut-Off Date (ICOD) of 2009-12-01, DIA document number DIA-08-1004-001. Released by DIA under FOIA and posted in the DIA FOIA Electronic Reading Room.

Inside cover reads: "This product is one in a series of advanced technology reports produced in FY 2009 under the Defense Intelligence Agency [redacted b(3) 10 USC 424] Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications (AAWSA) Program" and directs questions to the "AAWSA Program Manager, Defense Intelligence Agency, ATTN: [redacted], Bldg 6000, Washington, DC 20340-5100".

Author name is withheld in the DIA-released copy under FOIA exemption (b)(6); the "Prepared by:" line is withheld under (b)(3) 10 USC 424. The released cover therefore does not attribute the DIRD to a named author.

claims.text: The DIA letter of 9 January 2018 lists item 19 as "Warp Drive, Dark Energy and the Manipulation of Extra Dimensions, Dr R Obousy, Obousy Consultants." The government's own list names Obousy, not Eric Davis, as the author of record. The widespread press attribution of this paper to Davis alone is not supported by the DIA list.

EarthTech International's citation list gives the paper as "Obousy, R. K. and Davis, E. W. (2010), 'Warp Drive, Dark Energy, and the Manipulation of Extra Dimensions,' Defense Intelligence Reference Document, Acquisition Threat Support, DIA-08-1004-001, Acquisition Support Division (DWO-3), Defense Warning Office, Directorate for Analysis, Defense Intelligence Agency, Washington, DC." It is co-authored, with Obousy first named, which reconciles the DIA list with the popular attribution.
The released cover page reads "2 April 2010 / ICOD: 1 December 2009 / DIA-08-1004-001." The author line is redacted under (b)(6).

One of the first two DIRDs to reach the public internet, appearing on a website operated by Corey Goode in an item dated 18 December 2017. Davis confirmed by email to the researcher Isaac Koi that the circulating copy was genuine.

connections.label: Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications Program (AAWSAP)
connections.note: The released document names the programme itself. Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications (AAWSA) Program' - the redaction between them is (b)(3):10 USC 424. Verified by downloading this DIRD and scanning its full text on 23 August 2026. The scans are OCR-degraded, so the quotation is normalised from the damaged rendering.
